name: PGC 11179 (Hubble)
blurb: PGC 11179, a compact elliptical galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: pgc11179-hubble
story: PGC 11179 is a small, dense elliptical galaxy, a plausible relic of the massive, quiescent galaxies of the early universe. At its heart, a disk of gas whirls around a supermassive black hole that ALMA has weighed.

claims.text: PGC 11179 is a local massive, compact early-type galaxy
PGC 11179 is in a sample of nearby compact elliptical galaxies with HST imaging from program 13050
Compact elliptical galaxies have high central stellar mass densities
PGC 11179 is a plausible relic of z~2 massive, quiescent galaxies
ALMA observed a rotating circumnuclear gas disk in PGC 11179 and measured its supermassive black hole mass
PGC 11179 was imaged by HST WFC3 in program GO-13050
